prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Preset fallback choices, background render status indicators, and certain onboarding flow reorders were helpful.
Interactive screen redesigns, desktop hint notifications, and moving sign-in after photo upload hurt performance.
Copy changes, guidelines, layout tweaks, hints, incentives, and other flow additions showed no clear effect.
Predictions were underestimated for preset fallback choices and background render status indicators.
Predictions were consistently too high for redesigns, notifications, copy changes, guidelines, layout tweaks, incentives, and new flow additions.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, hint: +1.2% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, incentive: -5.1% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_flow: +3.8% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.0% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -1.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +4.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: +3.3% over 2 test(s)
- finish, notification: -8.9% over 1 test(s)
- home, redesign: -4.5% over 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +3.4% over 4 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: -1.2% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, new_flow: -1.9% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.8% over 3 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 79.3%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 81.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 65.6%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 86.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 23.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, new_screen] Pre-Render Desktop Environment Verification Screen: Inserts a new verification screen before pet rendering to test desktop display compatibility and screen bounds. (why: Support received 3 reports of pets failing to show on desktop/app not opening and 4 reports of misbehaving desktop features.)
1: [home, wait_info] Rendering Phase Audio Sound Cues: Plays subtle ambient hatch sound effects as pet generation progresses on the waiting screen. (why: Home wait step has a mean duration of 2336s, causing unengaged users to drift away while background generation occurs.)
2: [adoption, copy] Sync Safety Notice on Adoption Certificate: Updates the adoption certificate headline and hint to explicitly confirm account cloud sync state. (why: Support logged 8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
3: [finish, hint] Floating Desktop Tray Interaction Hint: Adds a floating hint box on the home intro screen detailing tray icon interaction and hotkeys. (why: 3 support tickets noted users were confused on how to hide, control, or converse with their companion post-setup.)
4: [home, notification] Completion Sound Alarm Trigger: Enables completion audio chime and step progress counter when rendering finishes on waiting screen. (why: Home step average duration is high (2336s mean), indicating users leave the app hidden in background without noticing completion.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Full Bleed Story Carousel Experience: Changes story screen layout to full bleed carousel mode accompanied by an animated mascot guide component. (why: Choose path funnel stage suffers from long mean times (514s) and a 20.7% early user drop-off.)

scores.note: Adding a new verification screen adds friction and redesigns/new flows historically perform poorly.
Wait time indicators and audio progress info consistently improve engagement on slow background steps.
Strong support evidence and low drop cost, but copy changes historically yield zero or negligible lift.
Addresses late-stage onboarding confusion with minor hint UI, showing mild historical success.
Notification additions have consistently hurt performance in past onboarding tests.
Layout tweaks and carousel redesigns incur high implementation cost and negative target lift.
